disclose: The releases kern with a legacy `kern` table (4132 to 4469 pairs per style) and have no GPOS; these sources kern through a GPOS kern feature, which is how fontc builds kerning. HarfBuzz shapes every kerned pair alike in both (the functional gate). Decided 2026-10-01: releases with an old kern table are accepted and disclosed.
